claims.head: The Penguins will send Letang and Solovyov at McBain
claims.call: The Penguins’ P3 (Letang and Solovyov) spends at least 31% of its 5-on-5 time against the Mammoth’s fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Penguins keep sending Letang and Solovyov out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Dan Muse has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ fourth lines. Tonight the Mammoth’s fourth line is McBain, Stenlund and But.

claims.head: Forecheck vs. Patience
claims.body: The Mammoth hound the puck, but the Penguins sit back. Utah is one of the league’s best for forecheck pressure, and Pittsburgh is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Mammoth to win more pucks back deep in the Penguins’ end.

notes.text: John Marino is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Andrew Peeke has taken his spot beside Nate Schmidt.
Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 7 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang.
Elmer Söderblom is on injured reserve (upper body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Evgeni Malkin is out (illness) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Bryan Rust is on injured reserve and has missed the last 2 games. Tommy Novak has taken his spot beside Sidney Crosby and Rickard Rakell.
Egor Chinakhov is expected back after missing 2 games.
Ilya Solovyov was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Kris Letang.
Rutger McGroarty was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Blake Lizotte and Andrei Kuzmenko.
Avery Hayes was added to the roster on Oct 25 and has played beside Hendrix Lapierre and Ville Koivunen.
Ilya Solovyov has started killing penalties: on the ice for 43% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, up from 5% last season.
Spencer Stastney is no longer killing penalties: 5% of the team’s shorthanded time in 7 games, down from 31% with his old team last season.

PIT.head: Close, but the Mammoth have the slight edge
PIT.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage, and the Mammoth will be without Marino. The Penguins’ best way to tip it is getting good looks.

UTA.head: Leaning the Mammoth’s way
UTA.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents lately, but Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage, and the Mammoth will be without Marino. Still, it’s close: the Penguins can make it interesting if they get good looks.

story.head: Forecheck vs. Patience
paras: The Mammoth won the first meeting this season, 5-4 in Utah. The Penguins have won two in a row. The Mammoth are 8-5-0.

items.text: The Mammoth have been without John Marino since Oct 17.

The Penguins are newly without Elmer Söderblom, Evgeni Malkin and Bryan Rust, and have been without Trevor van Riemsdyk since Oct 9. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, only the Maple Leafs and the Islanders are missing more right now.
Ben Kindel and Egor Chinakhov have missed the Penguins’ last two games.
Erik Karlsson has a point in five straight games against Utah.
